# Bethlehem Public Library

> A community-focused public library in Bethlehem, NY offering digital resources, makerspace access, children's programs, accessibility services, and room reservations.

Bethlehem Public Library serves the Delmar area of Albany County through the Upper Hudson Library System (UHLS). The library provides comprehensive services including early literacy programs, assistive technology, community meeting spaces, and specialized collections like a seed library.

## Key Topics

- Story time and early literacy
- Meeting rooms and space reservations
- Library card signup
- Accessibility services (ADA, ASL, Hearing Loops)
- Studio Makerspace
- Seed library
- Board of Trustees governance
- Assistive technology (Optelec, TBBL)
- Community programs and events
- Digital resources
- Children's programs
- Room reservation system (LibraryCalendar)
- Community feedback and planning
- Privacy and library policies
- Community television (BCN-TV)

## Getting Started

- [Welcome to Bethlehem Public Library!](https://www.bethlehempubliclibrary.org/welcome-to-bethlehem-public-library): Welcome guide introducing library cards, digital resources, and community services
- [Sign up for a library card](https://www.bethlehempubliclibrary.org/card-sign-up): Library card registration and signup for Bethlehem Public Library patrons
- [Services](https://www.bethlehempubliclibrary.org/services): Bethlehem Public Library services including accessibility, makerspace, and community resources

## Collections & Discovery

- [What's new?](https://www.bethlehempubliclibrary.org/whats-new): New acquisitions and catalog browsing for adult, children, and audiobook collections

## Children's Programs

- [Storytimes and early literacy](https://www.bethlehempubliclibrary.org/story-time): Children's storytimes, early literacy programs, and story walk events
- ["Tea with Oliver"](https://www.bethlehempubliclibrary.org/story-time/tea-with-oliver): Children's story time and preschool program featuring craft activities
- ["The Breaking News"](https://www.bethlehempubliclibrary.org/story-time/the-breaking-news): Story time with picture book learning extensions for children
- ["Wally Does Not Want a Haircut" and "Klondike, Do Not Eat Those Cupcakes!"](https://www.bethlehempubliclibrary.org/story-time/wally-does-not-want-a-haircut-klondike-do-not-eat-those-cupcakes): Children's story time with author reading and early literacy activities

## Facilities & Reservations

- [Book a space](https://www.bethlehempubliclibrary.org/book-a-space): Room and facility reservation system using LibraryCalendar for meetings and events

## Community & Governance

- [Board of Trustees](https://www.bethlehempubliclibrary.org/board-of-trustees): Library Board of Trustees governance, meetings, and administrative information
- [Library policies](https://www.bethlehempubliclibrary.org/board-of-trustees/library-policies): Bethlehem Public Library institutional policies and operational guidelines
- [Footnotes newsletter](https://www.bethlehempubliclibrary.org/library-newsletter-footnotes): Bethlehem Public Library Footnotes newsletter subscription and community bulletin
- [We Heard You!](https://www.bethlehempubliclibrary.org/library-brainstorming-workshop): Community feedback and strategic planning workshop for library renovation design
- [Racism and the Law: Confronting the Realities](https://www.bethlehempubliclibrary.org/racism-and-the-law-confronting-the-realities): Library program on civil rights, legal history, and social justice topics

## Optional

- [Privacy policy](https://www.bethlehempubliclibrary.org/board-of-trustees/privacy-policy): Data collection and confidentiality policy for Bethlehem Public Library users
- [Naming Opportunities and Name Designations](https://www.bethlehempubliclibrary.org/naming-opportunities-and-name-designations): Donor recognition and facility naming policy for Bethlehem Public Library
- [Sitemap](https://www.bethlehempubliclibrary.org/sitemap): Website navigation directory and services index for Bethlehem Public Library
